accepted.text: In August 2026, the delinquency rate of the whole system in Brazil was 5.0%.
The delinquency rate for companies (PJ) was 3.1% in August 2026.
The system delinquency rate was 0.9 percentage points higher than in the same month last year.
The individuals delinquency rate was 1.2 percentage points higher than in the same month last year.
Personal loans had the highest delinquency rate among product groups, at 11.6%.
